findings.problem: The Bedrock binding sends the system prompt as a plain text block with no cachePoint (bedrock.py:334). The entity-extraction system prompt is rendered once per run (operate.py:4655/4668) and is the same for every chunk and every gleaning call, about 1.5k tokens. AWS says Claude models on Bedrock do not cache requests without a checkpoint, and the repo's own Bedrock sample model is anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5 (env.example:1914). The Anthropic binding has the same gap (anthropic.py:208) and is already tracked (#4464, open PR #4729).
findings.change: Add an opt-in cache_system_prompt argument that appends {"cachePoint": {"type": "default"}} after the system text block, as #4729 does for Anthropic.
findings.why: Every extraction call pays full input price for the same ~1.5k-token prefix. Claude Haiku 4.5 has a 4,096-token minimum, so the system prompt alone will not cache there; models with a 512 or 1,024 minimum will.
findings.estimate: about 1.5M uncached prompt tokens per 1,000 extraction calls (about 42% of an average call); a cache read bills about a tenth of that on models where the prefix is long enough
findings.assumptions: system prompt about 1.5k tokens (the maintainers' own tiktoken estimate in #4464), chunk 1,200 tokens, one gleaning call per chunk; Bedrock Claude model whose minimum is at or below 1,024 tokens
findings.verify: Send two extraction calls within five minutes with cache_system_prompt=True and read usage.cacheReadInputTokens on the second; it is non-zero.
findings.confirm: How many extraction calls the deployment sends to a Bedrock Claude model with a 512 or 1,024 token cache minimum.

notes.title: Bedrock usage ignores cache reads and writes
notes.problem: Both usage paths pass inputTokens straight to TokenTracker (bedrock.py:400 streaming, :480 non-streaming). Converse reports inputTokens for uncached tokens only; cache reads and writes arrive in cacheReadInputTokens and cacheWriteInputTokens (AWS prompt caching page). With caching on (e.g. BEDROCK_LLM_EXTRA_FIELDS with a top-level cache_control, bedrock.py:356-358), prompt_tokens drops to the uncached remainder and the cache share is never reported. OpenAI and Gemini bindings already report cached_prompt_tokens (#4572, #4687).
notes.change: prompt_tokens = inputTokens + cacheReadInputTokens + cacheWriteInputTokens; report cacheReadInputTokens as cached_prompt_tokens.
notes.verify: Feed a Converse usage block with cacheReadInputTokens to a TokenTracker: prompt_tokens includes it and get_usage() shows cached_prompt_tokens.

notes.title: Public Claude 3 helpers name retired models
notes.problem: claude_3_opus_complete, claude_3_sonnet_complete and claude_3_haiku_complete hard-code claude-3-opus-20240229 (:462), claude-3-sonnet-20240229 (:483) and claude-3-haiku-20240307 (:504). Anthropic's deprecations page lists them retired on 2026-01-05, 2025-07-21 and 2026-04-20; requests return 404. Library helpers only: the server does not use the Anthropic binding and nothing but a test calls them.
notes.change: Remove the three helpers or point them at a current model; use anthropic_complete with LLM_MODEL instead.
notes.verify: grep for claude-3- under lightrag/ returns nothing.

notes.title: Responses binding drops cached prompt tokens
notes.problem: _usage_counts forwards input, output and total tokens only, so a run through the OpenAI Responses binding shows no cached_prompt_tokens in the TokenTracker, while the Chat Completions binding does since #4572.
notes.change: Read usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens and forward it as cached_prompt_tokens, keeping a reported zero.
notes.verify: A mocked Responses usage with input_tokens_details.cached_tokens=5 gives cached_prompt_tokens 5 in the tracker; absent or null details leave the field out.
